BPSC releases teacher recruitment calendar

The Bihar Public Service Commission on Saturday released the examination calendar for the recruitment of 27,000 school teachers across subjects.

According to the calendar, the written examinations will be held in December, with results expected by March next year and counselling to follow in April.

Aspiring candidates welcomed the announcement but urged the commission to stick to the schedule, citing delays in previous recruitment cycles.

The commission said admit cards would be issued online a fortnight before each paper, and examination centres have been planned in all 38 districts.
